days.title: Nature and Valleys of Pineto
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Pineta Sacchetti
stops.detail: Pineta Sacchetti, flat with hundreds of stone pine plants up to 30 meters high;

stops.name: Valle dell'Inferno
stops.detail: Valle dell'Inferno, an extensive valley that expands eastwards to the Park of Monte Ciocci and northwards to the Park of the Mimose;

stops.name: Parco delle Mimose
stops.detail: Parco delle Mimose, an equipped public park above the Valle dell'Inferno, between central Balduina and Columbus di Balduina.

stops.name: Pianoro di Proba Petronia
stops.detail: Pianoro di Proba Petronia, an equipped public park, located in Balduina Bassa.

days.title: History and Architecture of Balduina
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Acquedotto dell'Acqua Paola
stops.detail: The territory of Pineto Park preserves traces of presence as early as the Roman age; in fact, the Trajan aqueduct ran here, built in 109 AD and reused in the 17th century by the will of Pope Paul V, giving life to the Acqua Paola Aqueduct, which still today feeds the famous Fontanone del Gianicolo.

stops.name: Chiesa di Gesù Divino Maestro
stops.detail: Church of Jesus the Divine Master, a significant example of modernist architecture located in the Balduina district of Rome.

stops.name: Casale del Giannotto
stops.detail: Casale del Giannotto, a restored eighteenth-century farmhouse that today houses the Casa del Parco Library and cultural spaces.
